answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by binding voting power to locked capital rather than ephemeral identities. To prevent a hollow network, nodes must commit collateral, effectively creating an economic ember that ignites consensus participation. If an attacker attempts to flood the system, they face a meadow of financial losses, as slashing protocols destroy their stake, making the high cost of acquiring massive capital prohibitively expensive for Sybil agents.
